issues.summary: Cryptsetup reported a TPM disk-unlock error
issues.detail:
Cryptsetup reported a TPM unlock error during this boot. This does not establish whether a passphrase was entered or disk activation ultimately failed. Changed PCR values are one possible cause; the journal alone does not prove PCR drift.

Automatic TPM repair is disabled. Review the disk's existing TPM enrollment and policy before making changes.

tpm_evidence.message: Failed to unseal secret using TPM2: Operation not permitted
